name: Torque
description: A plain-spoken, price-first template for independent auto repair shops — reflective plate-white canvas, petrol-teal stamped type and one sticker-red accent, the shop's name stamped on a license plate in a 'Serviced by' dealer frame, a dashboard warning-light decoder that says what each light means and how urgent it is, a posted price board, and a sample estimate waiting on the customer's OK.
